import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
# rainfall within-region
for r,g in df.groupby('region'):
    m = smf.ols('species_richness ~ rainfall_mm', data=g).fit()

# bootstrap-ish: rainfall coef stability
d = df.dropna(subset=['rainfall_mm','species_richness'])
m = smf.ols('species_richness ~ rainfall_mm + C(region)', data=d).fit()
print(m.params['rainfall_mm'], m.pvalues['rainfall_mm'], m.conf_int().loc['rainfall_mm'].values)
